A bold, wearable piece of art. This statement necklace is handcrafted from polymer clay in a vibrant spectrum of colors — from deep ocean navy, through electric purple and cobalt blue, into rich teal and vivid greens.

The necklace features a mix of round beads and disc-shaped elements, all graduating in color for a rainbow-gradient effect. Strung on a sturdy dark navy leather cord with a slide clasp for easy wearing at any length.

Each piece is unique — slight variations in color and form are a natural part of the handmade process and make your necklace one-of-a-kind.

  • Material: Oven-baked polymer clay (Fimo Professional)
  • Cord: Genuine leather, dark navy, 2 mm
  • Clasp: Sliding toggle (adjustable length)
  • Bead size: Round beads 18–25 mm, discs 20–25 mm diameter
  • Weight: approx. 45 g
  • Finish: Matte (no varnish, natural clay texture)
  • Keep away from water — polymer clay is not waterproof
  • Do not expose to extreme heat or direct sunlight for prolonged periods
  • Store flat or hanging — do not crush or stack
  • Clean gently with a dry, soft cloth
  • Processing time: 1–3 business days (each piece is made to order)
  • Shipping: 3–7 business days to Europe; 7–14 days worldwide
  • Free shipping on orders over USD 100
  • Returns: 14-day hassle-free returns. Contact Suza via email.
  • All orders are shipped with tracking and packed in a branded gift box.
